mapper.select: SELECT g.id AS grantId, g.subject_type AS subjectType, g.subject_id AS subjectId, g.role_id AS roleId, r.code AS roleCode, r.name AS roleName, MIN(ri.distance) AS roleDistance, g.grant_type AS grantType, g.include_descendants AS includeDescendants FROM oa_iam.grant_record g JOIN oa_iam.role r ON r.id = g.role_id AND r.tenant_id = g.tenant_id AND r.status = 'ACTIVE' JOIN oa_iam.role_inherit ri ON ri.ancestor_role_id = g.role_id JOIN oa_iam.role_permission rp ON rp.role_id = ri.descendant_role_id AND rp.permission_id = #{permId} WHERE g.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND g.revoked_at IS NULL AND g.valid_from <= #{now} AND (g.valid_to IS NULL OR g.valid_to > #{now}) GROUP BY g.id, g.subject_type, g.subject_id, g.role_id, r.code, r.name, g.grant_type, g.include_descendants ORDER BY g.id
